Which statement explains why river water containing NPK fertilisers is harmful to aquatic life?
A
NPK fertilisers cause disease in plant and animal life.
B
NPK fertilisers contain harmful microbes.
C
NPK fertilisers cause deoxygenation of the water.
D
NPK fertilisers contain plastic particles.

options.label: A
options.text: NPK fertilisers cause disease in plant and animal life.

options.label: C
options.text: NPK fertilisers cause deoxygenation of the water.
